name: FOMO Boost
author: FOMO Boost

sections.description:
FomoBoost is a conversion-focused WordPress plugin that brings real-time social proof notifications to your WooCommerce store or any WordPress website. By displaying dynamic activity such as recent purchases, customer reviews, and low-stock alerts, FomoBoost helps build trust, reduce hesitation, and encourage faster purchasing decisions.

The plugin seamlessly integrates with the FomoBoost platform via API, allowing you to manage and customize notifications directly from your FomoBoost account. Please note that this plugin acts as a connector and requires an active FomoBoost account and API key from fomoboost.com to function.

Features

FomoBoost comes packed with powerful campaign and notification tools to maximize engagement and conversions:

  • Create Campaigns: Easily build and manage multiple social proof and engagement campaigns
  • Multiple Notification Types: Choose from a wide range of interactive formats, including:
    • Informational messages
    • Coupon offers
    • Live counters
    • Email collectors
    • Conversion notifications
    • Conversion counters
    • Video notifications
    • Audio notifications
    • Social share prompts
    • Reviews display
    • Emoji feedback reactions
    • Cookie notifications
    • Score feedback widgets
    • Request collectors
    • Countdown timers
    • Custom HTML blocks
  • Page Targeting:
    • Trigger on All Pages or specific URLs
    • Support for Exact Match URL targeting for precise placement control
  • Display Triggers: Choose when notifications should appear based on user behavior-
    • Delay Trigger – Show after a set time delay
    • Time on Site – Trigger based on engagement duration
    • Page Inactivity – Display when user becomes inactive
    • Page Views – Trigger after a specific number of page visits
    • Exit Intent – Show when user is about to leave the page
    • Page Scroll – Trigger based on scroll depth
    • Mouse Click – Activate on click interactions
    • Mouse Hover – Trigger when user hovers over elements
  • Display Frequency Control: Control how often notifications appear to avoid fatigue-
    • All the Time – Always eligible to display
    • Once per Session – Show once per browsing session
    • Once per Browser – Limit display per user browser
  • Re-Display Rules: Set smart re-engagement timing after a notification is closed-
    • Delay based on Time on Site, or
    • Delay based on Page Views (e.g., re-show after X pages viewed)

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and install
  4. Activate the plugin

External services

This plugin connects to the Fomo Boost API (https://fomoboost.com/) to send and receive notification data.

What it does:
– Sends notification data to the Fomo Boost server
– Receives campaign and pixel data

What data is sent:
– User activity data (such as clicks and actions)
– Website-related information

When data is sent:
– When a notification is triggered
– When the tracking pixel is executed

Service provider:
Fomo Boost – https://fomoboost.com/

Terms of Service:
https://fomoboost.com/page/terms-and-conditions

Privacy Policy:
https://fomoboost.com/page/privacy-policy

Getting Started

  1. Visit https://fomoboost.com and create an account
  2. Generate an API key from your account dashboard
  3. Copy your API key
  4. Go to Fomo-Boost > Settings in WordPress admin
  5. Paste your API key
  6. Click Save Changes

Add Pixel Code

  1. Get your tracking pixel code from Fomo Boost
  2. Go to Fomo-Boost > Pixel Code
  3. Paste your pixel code
  4. Save changes

Create Notifications

  1. Go to Fomo-Boost > Add New
  2. Select notification source (Reviews, Sales, Stock)
  3. Choose a campaign
  4. Select notification type
  5. Enter a name
  6. Enable or disable
  7. Click Create Notification

Manage Notifications

  1. Go to Fomo-Boost > All Notifications
  2. View or delete notifications
  3. Go to Fomo-Boost > Dashboard to see stats
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Fomo Boost”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Click Activate
